---
title: "Retrospective Model Visualization"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: scroll
    theme: flatly
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(shiny)

# Determine root path prefix
if (dir.exists('../data/imputed_sets')) {
  root_prefix <- '..'
} else if (dir.exists('data/imputed_sets')) {
  root_prefix <- '.'
} else {
  stop("Could not locate data/imputed_sets/ directory")
}

# Helper: latest file by pattern
latest_file <- function(dir, pattern) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  files[order(files)][length(files)]
}

# Load ground truth
data_dir <- file.path(root_prefix, 'data/imputed_sets')
actual_path <- latest_file(data_dir, '^imputed_and_stitched_hosp_.*\\.csv$')
actual_raw <- read_csv(actual_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# FIPS mappings
location_to_fips <- c(
  'Alabama'='01','Alaska'='02','Arizona'='04','Arkansas'='05','California'='06','Colorado'='08',

  'Connecticut'='09','Delaware'='10','District of Columbia'='11','Florida'='12','Georgia'='13',
  'Hawaii'='15','Idaho'='16','Illinois'='17','Indiana'='18','Iowa'='19','Kansas'='20',
  'Kentucky'='21','Louisiana'='22','Maine'='23','Maryland'='24','Massachusetts'='25',
  'Michigan'='26','Minnesota'='27','Mississippi'='28','Missouri'='29','Montana'='30',
  'Nebraska'='31','Nevada'='32','New Hampshire'='33','New Jersey'='34','New Mexico'='35',
  'New York'='36','North Carolina'='37','North Dakota'='38','Ohio'='39','Oklahoma'='40',
  'Oregon'='41','Pennsylvania'='42','Puerto Rico'='72','Rhode Island'='44','South Carolina'='45',
  'South Dakota'='46','Tennessee'='47','Texas'='48','Utah'='49','Vermont'='50','Virginia'='51',
  'Washington'='53','West Virginia'='54','Wisconsin'='55','Wyoming'='56','US'='US'
)
fips_to_name <- setNames(names(location_to_fips), location_to_fips)

# Prepare ground truth
actual_data <- actual_raw %>%
  transmute(
    location = location_to_fips[location_name],
    location_name = location_name,
    date = as.Date(date),
    actual_value = total_hosp
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(location), !is.na(actual_value), date >= as.Date('2024-10-01'))

# Helper to load forecast CSV
load_forecast_quantiles <- function(path, model_name, file_horizon) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
    mutate(
      model = model_name,
      reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
      target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date),
      location = as.character(location),
      output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
      value = as.numeric(value),
      horizon = file_horizon
    ) %>%
    select(model, reference_date, horizon, target_end_date, location, output_type_id, value)
}

# Load all retrospective forecasts
all_forecasts <- list()

for (h in 1:4) {
  path <- file.path(root_prefix, sprintf('forecasts/retrospective/Flusight-baseline_h%d_forecasts.csv', h))
  all_forecasts[[paste0('Baseline_h', h)]] <- load_forecast_quantiles(path, 'FluSight-baseline', h)

  path <- file.path(root_prefix, sprintf('forecasts/retrospective/arima/ARIMA_h%d_forecasts.csv', h))
  all_forecasts[[paste0('ARIMA_h', h)]] <- load_forecast_quantiles(path, 'ARIMA', h)

  # LGBM Blended (t10+t100+persistence with conformal CIs)
  path <- file.path(root_prefix, sprintf('forecasts/retrospective/lgbm_blended/LGBM-blended_h%d_forecasts.csv', h))
  all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_blended_h', h)]] <- load_forecast_quantiles(path, 'LGBM-blended', h)

  path <- file.path(root_prefix, sprintf('forecasts/retrospective/lgbm_enhanced_t10_bounded/TwoStage-FrozenMu_h%d_forecasts.csv', h))
  all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_bounded_h', h)]] <- load_forecast_quantiles(path, 'LGBM-bounded', h)

  # LGBM Bounded Wide variants 1-5 (enhanced features)
  for (v in 1:5) {
    path <- file.path(root_prefix, sprintf('forecasts/retrospective/lgbm_enhanced_t10_bounded_wide_%d/TwoStage-FrozenMu_h%d_forecasts.csv', v, h))
    all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_bounded_wide_', v, '_h', h)]] <- load_forecast_quantiles(path, sprintf('LGBM-bounded-wide-%d', v), h)
  }

  # LGBM Bounded Wide 4 Non-Enhanced (default state lag features)
  path <- file.path(root_prefix, sprintf('forecasts/retrospective/lgbm_t10_bounded_wide_4/TwoStage-FrozenMu_h%d_forecasts.csv', h))
  all_forecasts[[paste0('LGBM_bounded_wide_4_ne_h', h)]] <- load_forecast_quantiles(path, 'LGBM-bounded-wide-4-ne', h)

  path <- file.path(root_prefix, sprintf('forecasts/retrospective/svm_t100/svm_retrospective_h%d.csv', h))
  all_forecasts[[paste0('SVM_h', h)]] <- load_forecast_quantiles(path, 'SVM', h)
}

# Adaptive Ensemble
ens_files <- list.files(
  file.path(root_prefix, 'forecasts/retrospective/ensemble'),
  pattern = 'AdaptiveEnsemble_retrospective_.*\\.csv',
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(ens_files) > 0) {
  ens_list <- lapply(ens_files, function(fp) {
    read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
      mutate(
        model = 'AdaptiveEnsemble',
        reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
        target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date),
        location = as.character(location),
        output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id),
        value = as.numeric(value),
        horizon = as.integer(horizon) + 1L
      ) %>%
      select(model, reference_date, horizon, target_end_date, location, output_type_id, value)
  })
  all_forecasts[['Ensemble']] <- bind_rows(ens_list)
}

# Combine and summarize
forecasts_all <- bind_rows(all_forecasts) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), target_end_date >= as.Date('2024-10-01'))

forecast_summary <- forecasts_all %>%
  group_by(model, horizon, reference_date, target_end_date, location) %>%
  summarise(
    q025 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.025))],
    q25 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.25))],
    median = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.5))],
    q75 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.75))],
    q975 = value[which.min(abs(output_type_id - 0.975))],
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q025 = pmin(q025, q25, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = pmin(q25, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = pmax(q75, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = pmax(q975, q75, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    location_name = fips_to_name[location]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(location_name))

# Available models
all_models <- sort(unique(forecast_summary$model))

# Model colors
model_colors <- c(
  "AdaptiveEnsemble" = "#cc5200",
  "FluSight-baseline" = "#555555",
  "ARIMA" = "#1f77b4",
  "SVM" = "#2ca02c",
  "LGBM-blended" = "#9467bd",
  "LGBM-bounded" = "#e377c2",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-1" = "#8c564b",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-2" = "#17becf",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-3" = "#bcbd22",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-4" = "#7f7f7f",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-4-ne" = "#ff7f0e",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-5" = "#d62728"
)

# Fill colors (lighter versions)
model_fills <- c(
  "AdaptiveEnsemble" = "#ff944d",
  "FluSight-baseline" = "#999999",
  "ARIMA" = "#7fbfff",
  "SVM" = "#90ee90",
  "LGBM-blended" = "#c9b3d9",
  "LGBM-bounded" = "#f0b8d0",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-1" = "#c49a91",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-2" = "#9edae5",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-3" = "#dbdb8d",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-4" = "#c7c7c7",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-4-ne" = "#ffbb78",
  "LGBM-bounded-wide-5" = "#ff9896"
)
```

Sidebar {.sidebar}
=====================================

```{r}
checkboxGroupInput(
  "models",
  "Select Models:",
  choices = all_models,
  selected = c("AdaptiveEnsemble", "FluSight-baseline")
)

hr()

checkboxInput("show_95ci", "Show 95% CI", value = TRUE)
checkboxInput("show_50ci", "Show 50% CI", value = TRUE)
checkboxInput("show_median", "Show Median", value = TRUE)

hr()

p("Black line = Ground Truth")
p("Generated:", Sys.Date())
```

Horizon 1
=====================================

Row {data-height=1000}
-------------------------------------

```{r}
renderPlot({
  req(input$models)

  h_data <- forecast_summary %>%
    filter(horizon == 1, model %in% input$models, !location %in% c('US', '72'))
  actuals <- actual_data %>% filter(!location %in% c('US', '72'))

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = actuals, aes(x = date, y = actual_value), color = 'black', linewidth = 0.5)

  if (input$show_95ci && nrow(h_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(
      data = h_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = q025, ymax = q975, fill = model),
      alpha = 0.2
    )
  }

  if (input$show_50ci && nrow(h_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(
      data = h_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = model),
      alpha = 0.35
    )
  }

  if (input$show_median && nrow(h_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_line(
      data = h_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, y = median, color = model),
      linewidth = 0.6
    )
  }

  p + facet_wrap(~ location_name, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_colors, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_fills, drop = TRUE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
    ) +
    labs(title = "Horizon 1 (1-week ahead)", x = "Date", y = "Weekly Hospitalizations",
         color = "Model", fill = "Model")
}, height = 900)
```

US National
=====================================

Row {data-height=800}
-------------------------------------

```{r}
renderPlot({
  req(input$models)

  h_data <- forecast_summary %>%
    filter(location == 'US', model %in% input$models)
  actuals <- actual_data %>% filter(location == 'US')

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = actuals, aes(x = date, y = actual_value), color = 'black', linewidth = 0.7)

  if (input$show_95ci && nrow(h_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(
      data = h_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = q025, ymax = q975, fill = model),
      alpha = 0.2
    )
  }

  if (input$show_50ci && nrow(h_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_ribbon(
      data = h_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = model),
      alpha = 0.35
    )
  }

  if (input$show_median && nrow(h_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_line(
      data = h_data,
      aes(x = target_end_date, y = median, color = model),
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  }

  p + facet_wrap(~ horizon, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(horizon = function(x) paste("Horizon", x))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_colors, drop = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_fills, drop = TRUE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(title = "US National Forecasts", x = "Date", y = "Weekly Hospitalizations",
         color = "Model", fill = "Model")
}, height = 700)
```
